description.value:
You bind together magic and science to create a shield generator in an empty adjacent space. The generator is Small, visibly the source of the shields, has AC 10 and 40 Hit Points, and is immune to critical hits and precision damage. The generator also has the tech trait. This generator provides a small, shimmering light that covers you and all allies within 60 feet, granting a +1 status bonus to AC, as well as resistance 4 to acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, and sonic damage. If the generator is destroyed, the spell ends.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Build Shield Generator]

Heightened (+1) The generator's Hit Points increase by 10, and the resistance granted by the generator increases by 1.
